name: Infinite Spark | Luxury Unisex Perfume
description: Infinite Spark, inspired by the renowned Louis Vuitton Imagination, represents creativity and endless possibilities. It opens with a lively burst of citrus and calming neroli, giving a fresh, uplifting start. This is followed by the heart of the fragrance, where black tea and spicy cardamom blend seamlessly to create a rich, sophisticated aroma. The base features notes of Ambroxan, cedarwood, and musk, providing a smooth, lasting trail. This fragrance is versatile, making it perfect for both men and women, and ideal for any occasion. With a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, it delivers luxury and longevity in every spritz. Features Top Notes: Citrus, Neroli Heart Notes: Black Tea, Cardamom Base Notes: Ambroxan, Cedarwood, Musk Longevity: 8-10 hours (Very Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for daily wear, work settings, or evening gatherings Why Choose Infinite Spark? Inspired by the luxurious Louis Vuitton Imagination Crafted with premium up to 50% perfume oil concentration A sophisticated unisex scent that adapts to any occasion Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir in Pakistan Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume with natural oils Care: Store in a cool, dry place, avoiding direct sunlight Packaging: Delivered in a chic, travel-friendly bottle
